requirement: PROP shall deliver at least 1.46 N total thrust at a specific impulse of at least 2,100 s with any one thruster failed (N+1 units, used in rotation).
rationale: System thrust (SR-07, D-16) plus single-failure tolerance over 15 years. Baseline 5+1 units of the 5 kW European class at 25 kW; option 2+1 units of the 12 kW class at 24 kW (1.40 N) (D-20, A-27).

requirement: PROP shall store at least 3,400 kg of usable xenon in tanks qualified for at least 9 refill cycles.
rationale: Tank sized for the 3.1 km/s case at 25 kW; one refill per round trip (SR-05, SR-08).

requirement: PROP shall provide at least 90,000 h of thrusting over life (22.8 t of xenon). With 5+1 units in rotation this is about 75,000 h per unit, 5.0 rated lives of a 5 kW European-class thruster (29.9 lifetimes in total); with the 12 kW-class option about 62,000 h per unit, 2.7 rated lives (8.1 in total). No qualified thruster meets it.
rationale: Trade 1: about 90,000 h of thrusting over life at any power (D-18); wear counted in firing hours with rotation (A-27, D-20). Top item for the TRL and cost assessment.

requirement: PROP shall keep a disposal reserve of TBD kg of xenon that is never used for transfers.
rationale: Disposal delta-v (TBD) through the rocket equation.

requirement: The thruster strings, their PPUs and pointing mechanisms shall be grouped in one exchangeable propulsion module of no more than 0.4 t (with maturity margin), so that a replacement module fits the spare capacity of a resupply launch.
rationale: Life strategy D-29: 8 exchanges at 15,000 h rated string life, 4 at 20,000 h, 1 at 50,000 h (thruster_life_strategies.csv); module 380 kg against 3.46 t spare capacity (CALC-45, CALC-46).

requirement: PROP shall provide translation and attitude thrust for proximity operations and capture, independent of the Hall thrusters (delta-v per rendezvous TBD, propellant TBD).
rationale: About 1.5 N of Hall thrust on a 13.6 t stack cannot translate the tug for close approach; gap found by the mass budget (D-31).

requirement: PWR shall deliver at least 25 kW to the thruster power processing units plus 2 kW of platform load at end of life.
rationale: SR-11 (D-16) plus the platform allocation A-21, confirmed by the logical architecture power budget: highest mode (Docking) 1.33 kW with 20 % margin (CALC-32).

requirement: Solar array sizing shall include the end-of-life degradation from the total ionising dose of SR-13 (TBD).
rationale: Many radiation-belt passages per trip in a GTO-class staging orbit.

requirement: The battery shall power the 2 kW platform allocation, thrusters off, through eclipses of up to 2.5 h within a depth of discharge of 60 % (at least 8.8 kWh).
rationale: Thrusting pauses in eclipse (A-17); the platform must not. CALC-33; A-28, A-31.

requirement: The solar array shall provide at least 29.1 kW at end of life (about 38.9 kW at beginning of life with an end-of-life to beginning-of-life ratio of 0.75, TBC by PWR-02).
rationale: 25 kW to EP + 2 kW platform + 0.69 kW battery recharge, divided by 95 % distribution efficiency (CALC-34 to CALC-36; A-30, A-32).

requirement: DRI shall provide one androgynous docking port (standard TBD, IBDM-compatible TBC) used for cargo capture, destination docking and supplier mating.
rationale: One port for all partners keeps the mass and the qualification effort down.

requirement: DRI shall include a xenon fluid coupling able to transfer at least 2,550 kg per refuelling from a passive propellant module within 21 days (an average of about 121 kg/day, IR-02; leak rate TBD).
rationale: D-17 (R1 fluid transfer); ESPRIT refuelling heritage; A-26.

requirement: DRI shall withstand at least 54 mating cycles.
rationale: 3 matings per round trip (cargo and propellant stack, destination, return cargo hand-over) x 9 trips x 2 margin (D-17).
